turns.text: Hello, my print still hasn't arrived and I need help with the delivery.
Hello, I can help with your delivery. To find your order, please send me the order number (it starts with SC- followed by four digits) and the email address you used when you placed the order.
I'm filing a complaint with the consumer authority ANPC today. I'll also contact my bank for a chargeback and leave a public review.

I understand your frustration, and I have passed your message to a colleague who will take over from here. Please keep your order number and the email you used handy, as they will need them to check your delivery.

input.summary: Customer says their print has not arrived and wants help with the delivery. They announced they are filing a complaint with the consumer authority ANPC today, will request a chargeback from their bank, and will leave a public review. Not yet verified: no order number or email was provided, so no order details were looked up or shared.
